# Ashutosh Mahapatra

> Ashutosh Mahapatra runs Ashutosh Writes, a three-person editorial and engineering team in Bhubaneswar, India. We build on-page SEO, GEO and AEO pages for B2B SaaS and fintech teams: primary-source research, writing and custom-coded pages built to rank in Google and be cited in AI answers.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://ashutoshwrites.online/): Services (on-page SEO, AEO, GEO), pricing in USD, portfolio samples and contact details.
- [Blog](https://ashutoshwrites.online/blog): Index of long-form writing on AI, fintech, cybersecurity and search.
- [Selected Work](https://ashutoshwrites.online/work): Case-study view of independent samples across AI, cybersecurity and fintech.
- [Author: Ashutosh Mahapatra](https://ashutoshwrites.online/author/ashutosh-mahapatra): Biography, coverage areas, social profiles, and an archive of every published article.

## Articles

- [Shadow AI Inside Approved SaaS: How Agents Inherit Access](https://ashutoshwrites.online/static-blogs/byoa-shadow-ai-blog.html): How vendor-embedded AI agents inherit OAuth scope from platforms already approved, what EchoLeak, Drift and Vercel prove and do not prove, dated EU AI Act obligations, and a governance framework for security teams.
- [Untangling Liability in Visa's New Agentic Commerce Dispute Rules](https://ashutoshwrites.online/visa-agentic-commerce-disputes-seo.html): Who bears the loss when an AI agent buys the wrong thing, checked against primary rule text.
- [AI Personal Finance 2026: Stats, Tools & Risks Explained](https://ashutoshwrites.online/static-blogs/ai-personal-finance-2026.html): Sourced statistics, structural trends and the risks most AI-finance coverage misses.
- [AI vs Human Content in 2026: The Authenticity Premium](https://ashutoshwrites.online/static-blogs/ai-authenticity-premium-2026.html): What ranking and audience data show about AI-generated versus human-written content.
